title: Doctor-Patient Relationship in China
synopsis: Tensions between doctors and patients have long been a problem in Chinese society. Lately a doctor was murdered by a former patient, which stirred up the debate again.

fullText.simplified:
中国的医患关系

前不久发生的陈仲伟事件，将中国的医患矛盾又一次推到了舆论的风口浪尖上。中国社会的医患矛盾由来已久。“看病难”一直以来是中国的重大民生问题之一。近几年来，医患关系越来越紧张。在患者眼中，医生是能妙手回春的“超人”，如果未能达到预期效果，患者就会感到失望，甚至绝望。而医生因为患者的不信任也越来越不敢或者不想承担风险，从而遵循最保守的疗法。而这种行为在患者眼里很有可能成为医生“不负责任”的表现。这样的恶性循环滋生于医生和病患双方权利不平等、对疾病认识的不平等的土壤中。中国的医患矛盾问题，任重而道远。
fullText.traditional:
中國的醫患關係

前不久發生的陳仲偉事件，將中國的醫患矛盾又一次推到了輿論的風口浪尖上。中國社會的醫患矛盾由來已久。“看病難”一直以來是中國的重大民生問題之一。近幾年來，醫患關係越來越緊張。在患者眼中，醫生是能妙手回春的“超人”，如果未能達到預期效果，患者就會感到失望，甚至絕望。而醫生因為患者的不信任也越來越不敢或者不想承擔風險，從而遵循最保守的療法。而這種行為在患者眼裡很有可能成為醫生“不負責任”的表現。這樣的惡性循環滋生於醫生和病患雙方權利不平等、對疾病認識的不平等的土壤中。中國的醫患矛盾問題，任重而道遠。

sentences.traditional: 如果未能達到預期效果，患者就會感到失望，甚至絕望。

sentences.english: But when the expected results are not achieved, patients feel quite disappointed, and even start to despair.

sentences.traditional: 從而遵循最保守的療法。

sentences.traditional: 而這種行為在患者眼裡很有可能成為醫生“不負責任”的表現。
sentences.pinyin: ér zhè zhǒng xíng wéi zài huàn zhě yǎn lǐ hěn yǒu kě néng chéng wéi yī shēng bú fù zé rèn de biǎo xiàn
sentences.english: They follow the most conservative treatment because of the lack of trust from patients.

sentences.simplified: 这样的恶性循环滋生于医生和病患双方权利不平等、对疾病认识的不平等的土壤中。
sentences.traditional: 這樣的惡性循環滋生於醫生和病患雙方權利不平等、對疾病認識的不平等的土壤中。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng de è xìng xún huán zī shēng yú yī shēng hé bìng huàn shuāng fāng quán lì bù píng děng duì jí bìng rèn shi de bù píng děng de tǔ rǎng zhōng
sentences.english: This behavior, in turn, reinforces the views of some patients that doctors are irresponsible.

sentences.simplified: 中国的医患矛盾问题，任重而道远。
sentences.traditional: 中國的醫患矛盾問題，任重而道遠。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó de yī huàn máo dùn wèn tí rèn zhòng ér dào yuǎn
sentences.english: This vicious circle is the result of a gap between the rights of patients and doctors, as well as a gap in their knowledge of diseases.
The problem between patients and doctors in China is a complex issue and has a long way to go.

raw.synopsis: Tensions between doctors and patients have long been a problem in Chinese society. Lately a doctor was murdered by a former patient, which stirred up the debate again.
sentence_translations: The Relationship Between Patients and Doctors in China
The recent incident of Dr. Chen Zhongwei has pushed the tension between patients and doctors to its highest point.
The tensions between patients and doctors in China have long been an issue.
“Limited accessibility to doctors” has always been one of the major social issues in China.
In the recent years, the relationship between patients and doctors is getting more and more tense.
In the eyes of patients, doctors are “supermen” who have miraculous cures and can bring the dying back to life.
But when the expected results are not achieved, patients feel quite disappointed, and even start to despair.
As for the doctors, they either do not dare, or simply don't want to take more risks.
They follow the most conservative treatment because of the lack of trust from patients.
This behavior, in turn, reinforces the views of some patients that doctors are irresponsible.
This vicious circle is the result of a gap between the rights of patients and doctors, as well as a gap in their knowledge of diseases.
The problem between patients and doctors in China is a complex issue and has a long way to go.
